text:
Brandon Hagel is day-to-day with an injury (Daily Faceoff) and missed Tampa's win over Washington on Tuesday, which is a real loss for a team that has been better with him than almost anyone in the league would guess.

His numbers are the kind that don't need luck. He has 13 goals on 12.6 expected, and his own chance rate of 1.85 expected goals per 60 is elite. Tampa has taken 65% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice, 12.55 points better than without him. Yet the Lightning have scored 8.3 fewer goals than those chances deserve while he's out there, which has cost him points. That usually swings back.

Evolving-Hockey had him 16th among forwards last season at 2.9 wins above replacement, with his team creating 0.44 more expected goals per 60 with him on (99th percentile). Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking backs it up: strong setup passing and plenty of shots off passes across the slot. Not bad for a sixth-round pick, 159th overall in 2016. When he returns, the points should start matching the play.
headline: Hagel's process is better than his points
